messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo checklist: payment channels & approver roster for Acme Health

Hi Alex + Priya — thanks for your time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our demo: 

- Current procurement signals: Priya mentioned Finance prefers PO for enterprise contracts, but the pilot team may be able to use a corporate card for an initial 3-month proof-of-value. Please confirm which route you prefer for the pilot.
- Items you requested: SOC 2 report, DPA, list of data residency options, and an example SOW. I attached a short procurement questionnaire (procurement_questions.xlsx) and our pricing brief comparing PO vs card (redwood_pricing_card_vs_po.pdf).
- Budget/approvals: Could you confirm the budget owner and finance sponsor for this project? We want to map the internal approval path (economic buyer, finance approver, and signatory). If helpful, a single line with names + emails is perfect.
- Marketplace: You asked about using the AWS Marketplace credits — please indicate marketplace interest (yes/no) and whether procurement requires a marketplace invoice.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Share the requested docs (I attached them).
2) Intro call with your procurement contact (Daniel) — would Thursday 8/22 at 10am PT work?
3) We’ll prepare an SOW template and a short commercial playbook that shows card vs PO economics for a 3-month pilot.

If you can confirm budget owner and whether the pilot will be card or PO, I’ll get everything ready.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: procurement_questions.xlsx, redwood_pricing_card_vs_po.pdf
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Daniel Epstein <daniel.epstein@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-21T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo checklist: payment channels & approver roster for Acme Health

Thanks Karthik — great demo. A few clarifications from Procurement/Finance: 

- Procurement owner: Daniel Epstein (copied). For anything > $25k/year, Finance requires a PO and our standard procurement terms. For pilots under $10k we can often use a corporate card. For this pilot we are leaning toward a card-based POC but need the estimated run-rate.
- Budget owner / economic buyer: Alex Turner (Product) will own budget approval for the POC, but Finance Sponsor for legal/PO is Sandeep Rao (sandeep.rao@acmehealth.com).
- Signatory: Legal generally signs for vendor contracts; however Procurement must approve payment method and invoicing.
- Marketplace: We prefer to use the AWS Marketplace only if Redwood can issue marketplace billing and accept marketplace credits; otherwise we will procure directly. Please confirm whether you can accept marketplace billing.

Action items for Redwood: please send estimated monthly spend bands for the pilot and a brief SOW. If you can, share the SOC 2 and DPA. We have availability for a procurement sync on Thursday 8/22 at 10am PT.

—Priya
Head of Growth Ops | Acme Health
priya.shah@acmehealth.com

Karthik / Laura — quick internal note before we reply to Acme: 

- Marketplace: confirm with Platform whether we can enable AWS Marketplace billing for a new account and whether there are any minimum invoice constraints. I think we can, but need a definitive yes/no and list of required customer details.
- Pricing bands: provide three tiers (pilot small: ~$2k–5k/mo, pilot med: ~$5k–12k/mo, full onboarding: $20k+/mo) and highlight token economics for short sequences.
- Legal redlines: if they will need a PO, we may need to route to Legal for minor payment-term changes. Laura, can you confirm estimated review turnaround if Procurement requests a PO?

Marissa
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

Hi Priya / Alex / Daniel — thanks for the quick clarification and for looping Daniel in. Attaching a short SOW template (SOW_template_v2.pdf) and our procurement questionnaire. Answers to your questions below: 

- Marketplace: We can accept AWS Marketplace billing for new customers, but it requires the customer to provide marketplace account details and there is an onboarding step. If you plan to use marketplace credits, we can route billing through marketplace. Please confirm.
- Estimated monthly spend bands for a 3-month pilot (approximate):
  • Pilot small: $2k–$5k/month (limited users, shorter context lengths)
  • Pilot medium: $5k–$12k/month (broader coverage, moderate token volume)
  • Pilot ramp (onboarding): $15k–$25k/month (broader footprint + SLA)

- Budget owner & sponsors (as provided): Alex Turner (economic buyer), Sandeep Rao (finance sponsor). Signatory will likely be Legal + Procurement. Daniel, can you confirm whether Procurement needs a specific PO template or any vendor setup forms?

Next steps:
1) Daniel — if Thursday 8/22 10am PT works, please send a calendar invite and we’ll include Laura from Legal if needed.
2) If you confirm card vs PO for the pilot I’ll send a short commercial summary that compares the economics and includes a trial usage estimate.
3) We’ll follow up with SOC 2 and DPA documents in a separate thread (internal note: pull from secure drive).

Thanks — I’ll be on the call and will bring Marissa for the commercial context.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
